rationale: All cited held texts re-hash to their pinned sha256 and every evidence record's char span reproduces its text exactly. Identity: held original is EO 11460, 34 FR 5535, signed March 20, 1969, establishing the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board; matches the API metadata (34 FR 5535, 1969-03-20) and 1989 row. I read it in full: secs. 1-5 create a continuing board, information access, appointments, staff and funding; sec. 6 revokes EO 10938; no term, sunset or savings language. Held EO 11984 (42 FR 23129, signed 1977-05-04, published 1977-05-06) says 'in order to abolish the President's Foreign Intelligence Advisory Board, Executive Order No. 11460 of March 20, 1969, is hereby revoked' - an express, whole-order, unqualified revocation by the President naming the target; no exception, delay or savings. The ACT span (475-919) is in that text. Earlier/contrary end: cruden number search (6 hits in 5 files) finds only EO 11905 sec. 6(a) and 6(f) ('remains in effect', a continuance statement, not an end), EO 11985 sec. 6 deleting 6(a)'s cross-reference sentence and subsection (f) on 1977-05-13 (after 11984; housekeeping, not an end or revival), and 11984 itself. The held FR 11905 text is a partial (definitions) extract, but the app-text copy contains the quoted sentences, so the producer's description is true. No later held order cites 11460, so no revival evidence (a later new PFIAB order would be a new instrument, not revival). History flags list is empty; both observations are editorial corroboration only, as the producer treats them. NO is supported by ACT/ACTOR_TEXT evidence; proposed_intervals is empty and the producer correctly asserts no effective date (signing is not an effective date). Lifecycle gaps (first-effective date, no complete later-source search, residual appointments) are honestly retained and are not status gaps. Accepted only as a nonauthoritative provisional NO proposal; original_pages_confirmed remains false.

rationale: Hashes and spans of all held records verify. Identity: held original is EO 11537, 35 FR 9991, signed June 16, 1970, a single command amending Selective Service Regulations sec. 1631.7(a) by inserting a 'Provided' proviso for I-A/I-A-O registrants who fail to report for physical examination; no term or savings clause. Held EO 12553 (51 FR 7237, signed 1986-02-25) orders that the listed 'Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked', and PDF page 13 (= p. 7241) lists '11537 Amending Selective Service regulations', with no exception or savings - so the producer's source reading is accurate, and EO 11563 does restate 1631.7 citing 11537 among the prescribing orders. But the decision's express recommendation is 'yes' (in force), which is the opposite of what its own rationale concludes ('That is an express, unqualified revocation of the whole order, so a NO is supported') and of its sole basis record. A YES also requires a held CURRENT: predicate checked through 2026-10-14; none is cited and current_predicate_checked_through is null. Cruden number search found no held order citing EO:11537 that could show revival (0 hits under its pattern; 11563 and 12553 cite it in text forms it does not match). The decision is internally inconsistent and its recommendation is unsupported by the evidence; it must be rejected even though the underlying evidence would support a NO. History flags are empty; the Proc. 3989 cross-reference is honestly left as a lead.
